_rationale: PNT (positioning/navigation/timing)-lite King affinity is equatorial-MEO, the real-world analog altitude band for GPS-like constellations (R-203 §3.1's MEO band definition, ~2,000-35,786 km) — a doctrinally recognizable, non-arbitrary choice distinct from SATCOM's GEO and ISR's LEO-polar affinities.
